public.title: Decode Ways
public.description: A through Z correspond to decimal codes 1 through 26. Return the number of ways to split a digit string into valid codes; codes cannot start with zero. Empty input returns zero. Length is 0 to 30.
hints: Count ways ending in a one-digit or two-digit code.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Dynamic programming tracks the previous two prefix counts. Zero cannot form a one-digit code. Time O(n), extra space O(1).
